subject: Trading
title: Iron Condors
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Iron Condors.

hook.text: Sell a call spread above the market. Sell a put spread below it. Collect premium from both. That's an iron condor.

buildup.text: An iron condor profits when the stock stays within a range. It's a bet on low volatility—the market going nowhere.

discovery.text: Maximum profit is the total premium collected. Max loss is the spread width minus premium—both defined upfront.

twist.text: Iron condors have high win rates but small gains and large maximum losses. One big move can erase many small wins.

climax.text: They're popular among income-focused traders who accept frequent small wins with occasional larger losses.

punchline.text: Profit from boredom. Lose when the market wakes up.

quiz.question: When does an iron condor profit?
options: When the stock stays within a defined range
